{{Quote|The Vanqors are greedy and ruthless. If they have something to teach us, I have no desire to learn it ... I am beginning to wonder who the traitor is here!|Mezdec to Thik, his TY44 surveillance outpost comrade|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth">''[[Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth]]''</ref>}}
'''Mezdec''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] who sent strategic information on [[Typha-Dor]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] while posing as a communications officer working for the Typha-Dor resistance at a surveillance outpost on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[TY44]].

Mezdec, the husband of TY44 outpost crew leader [[Shalini]], stole from Shalini's utility belt a disk containing the planet Vanqor's invasion plans for Typha-Dor. Mezdec then created another disk with falsified invasion plans that he delivered to the Typha-Dor [[High General]] [[Bycha]], who accepted the information as authentic and reliable—upon which the planet's military leadership based what it believed would be a surprise preemptive strike against the invaders.

After being exposed for his espionage activity in front of the [[Typha-Dor High Council]] by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Mezdec was placed under arrest by order of General Bycha.
